Evidence: BNPB data, Red Cross, Flores island
#Aletheia #Indonesia #News

Authorities report mounting casualties and relief efforts following a powerful earthquake in eastern Indonesia.

A magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck Indonesia's Flores island, triggering nearly 1,600 aftershocks and displacing thousands of residents into makeshift tents.

The Bright Side:
Improved access to isolated communities is allowing medical teams and aid distribution to ramp up swiftly.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Accurate alignment across all planes (WHO, WHAT, WHERE). Logistics limit speed, but humanitarian intent is genuine.

When you map the humanitarian response against crisis realities, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace through active rescue and solidarity.

The Unavoidable Lie: Relief operations face zero logistical hurdles across damaged terrain.
